name: stat-cards-trend
title: Stat cards: With trend badges
description: Four figures for the month in one card split four ways, each with its change on last month as an up or down badge and a line of context.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>

files.content:
// Stat cards with trend badges: four figures for the month so far, in one card split by hairlines. Each // badge shows the change against the same days of last month; its color says whether the move is good // for that figure (outstanding going up is bad news), and its arrow says which way it went. Screen // readers get the change as a sentence. import { ArrowDownRight, ArrowRight, ArrowUpRight, CircleDollarSign, Clock3, FileText, Users } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" const STATS = [ { label: "Revenue", value: "$48,210", change: "12.4%", up: true, good: true, icon: CircleDollarSign, context: "Up from $42,880 in October", }, { label: "Outstanding", value: "$9,860", change: "17.1%", up: true, good: false, icon: FileText, context: "5 open invoices, 2 of them late", }, { label: "Clients", value: "64", change: "6", up: true, good: true, icon: Users, context: "6 new this month, none lost", }, { label: "Days to get paid", value: "11", change: "3 days", up: false, good: true, icon: Clock3, context: "Your terms are 14 days", }, ] // One card split into four: stacked on phones, two by two on tablets, a row on desktops. const DIVIDERS = ["", "border-t sm:border-t-0 sm:border-l", "border-t lg:border-t-0 lg:border-l", "border-t sm:border-l lg:border-t-0"] export default function StatCardsTrend() { return (

November so far

Nov 1 to 24, against the same days of October.

{STATS.map((s, i) => { const Arrow = s.up ? ArrowUpRight : ArrowDownRight return (
{s.label}
{s.value} {s.up ? "+" : "−"} {s.change} , {s.up ? "up" : "down"} {s.change} on October, {s.good ? "a good change" : "a change for the worse"}.
{s.context}
) })}
) }
